description: Verify real app behavior with Reticle and report evidence-backed pass, fail, or unknown results.

capabilities: Inspect app behavior and explain inconclusive checks
defaultPrompt: Use Reticle to verify this app change and report the actual verdict.
Replay relevant saved flows and identify regressions.
Investigate this UI bug and prove the fix in the running app.
interface.longDescription: Use Reticle to check whether a coding change works in a running web or desktop app. Drive meaningful user journeys, inspect network and application state, and return evidence-backed yes, no, or unknown verdicts with source locations when available. Setup and project instrumentation can modify files and install development dependencies, so ask before initializing a project. Reticle's local MCP server is required for live app verification.

publication.release_notes: Initial portable package for Reticle's live application verification workflow.

name: reticle-verification
